summary: Iteration 2 — focused retest of the two issues flagged in iteration_1. Both fixes verified. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_fixes_iteration2.py (4 tests) all pass — GET /api/admin/stats now returns 200 with the full expected payload shape (total_users, total_items, adv_items, today_logins, week_logins, online_now, vip_active, hardcore_users, totp_items — all ints), rejects missing-token (403) and non-admin bearer (403); admin staged login (login -> verify-birthday) smoke still works end-to-end; items CRUD smoke (create + list + delete) passes with no regression. Frontend: at 1280x800, admin login + birthday verification succeeds and vault dashboard loads; measured topbar layout confirms h1 'Good to see you, TopPass5' (y=81->129) and .top-actions row (y=153->203) no longer overlap — actions wrap cleanly to a new row below the heading with a 24px gap, satisfying the @media(max-width:1380px) rule in App.css. Screenshot captured at /app/test_reports/vault_dashboard_1280.png.
critical_code_review_comments: Both fixes correctly applied: @router.get('/admin/stats') decorator added at server.py L877; .topbar/.top-actions now use flex-wrap plus @media(max-width:1380px) rule that forces .topbar > div:first-child and .top-actions to flex-basis 100%, cleanly separating rows.
Carry-over from iteration 1 (not re-flagged, still valid long-term): server.py ~1150 lines should be split into routers; CORS_ORIGINS='*' acceptable for dev only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login -> birthday -> dashboard; topbar layout at 1280px verified)

rca of the issue: Both root causes from iteration_1 confirmed resolved: (1) admin_stats handler now registered via @router.get('/admin/stats') decorator — endpoint reachable; non-admin tokens correctly rejected by the admin dependency.
